approaches.title: Sweep logs across sorted queries
approaches.summary: Sort logs and queries by time, then sweep through each query’s time window to count active servers. The initial implementation is incorrect; the revision maintains per-server counts as the window moves.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Attempts to process sorted queries with log pointers and a per-query set of servers. This implementation is marked wrong.
Uses left and right pointers with per-server log counts to maintain the active window and count servers with requests.
